models_evaluated: two Bayesian deep learning segmentation models

links.outcome: Whether uncertainty measures predict quality of deep learning tumor segmentation
links.effect: Uncertainty-based approach predicted segmentation quality in 86.6% of cases, identified low-performance cases for semi-automated correction, and visualized likely failure regions.
links.quote: We show that our uncertainty-based approach accurately predicts the quality of the deep learning segmentation in 86.6% of cases, identifies low performance cases for semi-automated correction, and visualizes regions of the scans where the segmentations likely fail.

unlisted_practices: Using Bayesian uncertainty maps to flag low-quality segmentations for semi-automated correction

screen.reason: Evaluates using uncertainty quantification to flag low-quality segmentations and identify cases requiring semi-automated clinician correction.

primary.practice: uncertainty quantification for quality prediction and selective human review
